page.title: False Flag Detector
page.t: Reports ships flying under a false flag that any of your ships, stations or satellites can see. Unlocked by research.
Cross-checks transponder codes against hull signatures across your sensor network. Ships flying under a false flag that any of your ships, stations or satellites can see are reported.
Matches hull signatures against faction registries, so every false flag report also names the true owner of the ship.
